links.note: research/isogeny_class_ic_yield_20261102/p1_eccp131/PROTOCOL.md is the narrative; this file records it. Section 14 of the narrative is amendment A1: the run scope is tier 1 (m2t3, m3t2) only, route local, isolation L0 on a loaded host, 2 workers, clock descriptive only. Tier 2 (m2t4) is deferred, not dropped.

question: Across the 28 curves of ECCp-131's isogeny class that can be built (E0 and the 27 Elkies l-neighbours, l <= 150), do the algebraic parameters of the PKM-tower plus Semaev decomposition system at toy tower sizes (XL/Macaulay closure degree D_solve of this study's engine, first fall degree, Macaulay matrix size and rank profile, field-operation count, CPU time) and the per-trial relation yield differ from curve to curve beyond what presentation and noise explain?

claims.text: The 27 neighbours, their isogenies and the transported planted DLP are correct (kernel degree (l-1)/2, x-map degrees (l, l-1), homomorphism on random points, #E' = n, image of the generator has order n, phi(kP) = k phi(P)).
Full-width per-trial yield of any fixed-size factor base is the same formula on every curve of the class and astronomically small; it is predicted analytically (PROTOCOL.md section 3), not observed.

For the PKM isogeny-tower factor base and the Semaev systems at m = 2 (t = 3) and m = 3 (t = 2), the XL/Macaulay closure degree D_solve (refutation degree for null targets; not F4's solving degree), first fall degree, rank profile and operation count of the transported-target systems on the 27 neighbours are inside the A/A band of E0.
claims.if_supported: null for the counted metrics at toy size: lead closed at this resolution; nothing about ECCp-131 at full width (C5)
claims.if_not_supported: an anomaly with its arm and target is reported; a class effect is detected only under the decision rule and triggers a follow-up protocol, not a claim

claims.text: The instrument can see an algebraic change: adding a known quadric to a planted E0 system lowers D_solve by at least 1 on every planted target, and every planted row has n_standard_monomials = K and planted_verified = true.
claims.if_supported: a null in C3 is informative at this resolution
claims.if_not_supported: a null in C3 is not informative; the instrument is reported as insensitive

claims.text: No statement about ECCp-131 at full width (p about 2^131, a real factor base), security, speed, or an improvement over the index-calculus baseline; no rho reference or section 5a band applies.

hypotheses.statement: For null (inconsistent) targets the counted metrics are structure-determined and identical on every arm (D_solve, first fall, rank profile, rows, cols, field multiplications); only cpu_s varies, inside the A/A band; the per-curve factor-base size B_c is a presentation effect.
hypotheses.mechanism: The system's monomial support and degrees depend on the family (m, t, tower) only; the curve enters through the coefficients a, b, x_R of S3, and a prime-field curve of about 131 bits offers no subfield or endomorphism to align them. All 28 curves have order n.

null_population.description: 27 random (a, b) over the same p; same system shape and engine; the population range of every counted metric.
null_population.generator: p1_eccp131 run --rnd 27: a, b = SHA-256(seed|rnd|i|a), (seed|rnd|i|b) reduced mod p, seed 20261102; target abscissa is a random point per target

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: one p1_eccp131 binary per run, built --locked at the commit named in the card
factors.how: binary sha256 in every row header and bound by the card

factors.name: host_and_isolation
factors.how: isolation L0 on a loaded host; header cpu and nproc recorded; the clock is descriptive only; counted metrics do not depend on the host

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: per (rep, config, kind, tau) slot the arm order is a SHA-256-derived shuffle (seed 20261102); slots run in a fixed order

factors.name: targets_and_seeds
factors.how: 32 null targets k_tau = SHA256(seed|target-k|tau) mod (n-2) + 1, paired across arms; 8 planted per curve; every random choice SHA-256(seed|label), nothing chosen after a look

factors.name: workers
factors.how: amendment A1; the job list and order do not depend on it

factors.name: added_quadric
factors.how: one random quadric through the planted point, E0 and AA_repeat only

seed_derivation.note: every random choice is SHA-256("20261102|label"): targets, planted points and signs, random curves, the A/A permutation, ladder coefficients, schedule order; master seed 20261102 passed as --seed; no seed chosen after a look

instance_sampling.rule: 32 null targets per config seeded by k_tau = SHA256(seed|target-k|tau) mod (n-2) + 1 (target 0 is the planted-DLP point), 8 planted targets; the curve set is enumerated completely (E0, the 27 neighbours l <= 150, iso, 27 random curves)

blinding.how: analyze --mask replaces neighbour and random-curve names by hashes; E0 and the A/A arms stay labelled; the key is written next to the output and opened only after the analysis output is frozen

power.note: instances = 32 null + 8 planted targets per arm and config; replicates = 3 reps (counts are deterministic, so reps buy the clock only); decisions use percentile bootstrap over targets at level 0.9995 with 40000 resamples (Bonferroni over 27 neighbours x 4 primary metrics = 108 tests at family alpha 0.05, PROTOCOL.md section 8); a single target with a different D_solve is visible (1 of 32 pairs); the ladder control is the instrument-sensitivity check; the 108-test divisor is unchanged by amendment A1 (tier 2 deferred).

preflight_runtime.measured_on: research/isogeny_class_ic_yield_20261102/p1_eccp131/smoke/smoke_timings.txt and PROTOCOL.md section 10: single-thread CPU per attempt on the 3-core builder sandbox (m2t3 null 0.38 s, planted 0.17 s, ladder 0.03 s; m3t2 null 1.74 s, planted 1.76 s, ladder 0.31 s); total = tier 1 thread CPU 2,370 s (m2t3) + 10,350 s (m3t2) = 12,720 s = 3.5 CPU-hours; wall with 2 uncontended workers about 6,360 s

primary.name: XL/Macaulay closure degree
primary.definition: First Macaulay degree D at which n_std = K and every variable has a pure power as a leading monomial (K = exact solution count over the closure); for K = 0 the refutation degree (first D with the constant 1 as a leading monomial). It is not F4's solving degree and not a degree of regularity: on the 147 comparable systems of CROSSCHECK.md it is strictly above F4's top step degree.

primary.name: observed first fall degree
primary.definition: First D at which a new pivot has leading degree below D.

primary.name: Macaulay matrix rank at D_solve
primary.definition: Rank of the Macaulay matrix at D_solve (rank profile by leading degree is recorded beside it).

primary.name: F_p multiplications
primary.definition: Counted F_p multiplications of the engine call, including reduction and pivot inversions.

secondary.name: Macaulay rows at D_solve
secondary.definition: Cumulative rows of the Macaulay matrix at D_solve.

secondary.name: pivot applications
secondary.definition: Counted pivot applications of the engine call.

secondary.name: standard monomials at D_solve
secondary.definition: Number of standard monomials of the staircase at D_solve (equals K on a solved row).

secondary.definition: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID of the engine call; descriptive only under amendment A1 (L0, loaded host, co-tenants); decides nothing.

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design, amended by A1: configs m2t3 and m3t2, 58 arms, 32 null and 8 planted targets, 3 reps, 27 random curves, kinds null, planted, ladder (the arguments of run_full.sh tier1); then stop; no interim looks, no change of N, metric, null or threshold after data; m2t4 (tier 2) is deferred, no data are taken for it, reported as not run
a config where more than 5 percent of null attempts end cap_time is declared unresolved for that config (reported, not dropped); capped rows are kept as censored rows

invalidation_rules: a clock (cpu_s, wall_s) is descriptive only at L0 on a loaded host; counted metrics remain
an AA_repeat row whose counted metrics differ from E0's on the same target and rep invalidates the determinism assumption and is reported first
a planted row with n_standard_monomials_final != K_exact_solutions or planted_verified false is an instrument failure, reported first

decision_rule.text: A class effect is detected for a counted metric iff some neighbour's paired bootstrap interval excludes 1 and lies outside the interval of AA_perm (the re-encoding floor) and outside the range of the random-curve arms and the same neighbour repeats on the rep replicates. A difference in an exact count (D_solve, rank profile) on any target of any neighbour that is absent from the A/A arms is reported as an anomaly with its target and arm, even when the intervals include 1. Otherwise: null (H0 stands). The clock never decides under amendment A1. A null says nothing about full width (C5) and is informative only if the ladder positive control passes (C4).
decision_rule.threshold: paired bootstrap interval at level 0.9995 excludes 1 for a counted primary metric; ladder lowers D_solve by at least 1 on every planted E0 target
decision_rule.statistic: per arm and metric, geometric mean of the per-target ratio arm/E0 (paired by target); exact agreement fraction identical_count_profile_fraction; crossed two-way random-effects ICC (curves x targets) with target-resampling bootstrap
decision_rule.interval: percentile bootstrap over targets, level 0.9995, 40000 resamples
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: paired geometric-mean ratio vs E0 against the AA_perm and random-curve ranges; curve variance share (ICC)

graphs: per config and kind: paired ratio vs E0 per neighbour with the AA_perm and random-curve bands
ladder versus planted D_solve on E0

inadmissible: reading any result as a statement about ECCp-131 at full width, security or speed
calling D_solve F4's solving degree or a degree of regularity
ranking curves by cpu_s or wall_s at L0 on a loaded host
reading a null as informative when the ladder control failed
dropping or filling a config that did not run (m2t4 is reported as not run, deferred)
changing N, caps, thresholds or seeds after seeing results
comparing to rho or entering any row on the IC leaderboard or benchmarks/README.md (no matched rho reference applies)

literature.claim: within an isogeny class only transport cost, automorphisms and model presentation can differ

the engine agrees with an independent dense elimination, the exact solution enumeration and f4_fp (p < 2^32) on 252 mirror systems; D_solve is strictly above F4's top step degree on 147 of 147 systems

amendments.reason: Owner decision (2026-11-02, relayed by the main session): local route, reduced scope. P1 runs tier 1 only (m2t3 and m3t2, about 3.5 CPU-hours); tier 2 (m2t4, about 6.3 CPU-hours) is deferred, not dropped. Isolation L0 on a loaded host; P2's ecbench cells run one at a time in the same 4-core sandbox, so P1 uses 2 workers. No data of this protocol exist: runs/ does not exist; smoke/ and crosscheck/ are instrument tests.
changes: Run scope: tier 1 only, the arguments of run_full.sh tier1 with WORKERS=2; tier 2 (m2t4) deferred: recorded as not run, no data taken, not dropped from the preregistered design.
Route: local backend (no isolab-eks, no ecbench), isolation L0 on a loaded host; execution.timeout_seconds 21600.
Workers 2 instead of 4 (scheduling only; the job list and its order do not depend on it).
Clock (cpu_s, wall_s) descriptive only; counted metrics decide; the section 8 decision rule applies to counted metrics only.
The four primary metrics of the 108-test family are named: D_solve, first_fall_degree_obs, final_rank, field_mults (the four of claim C3).
Wording: D_solve is the XL/Macaulay closure degree, strictly above F4's top step degree on 147 of 147 comparable systems; it is not F4's solving degree.
Multiplicity family stays 108 tests; the tier 2 tests are not run and not removed from the divisor.
